overall_summary: Data shows clear audience preference for husband-wife relationship dynamics ('रिश्ते') and deep domestic emotional nuances over generic sad shayari or parenting videos. Top performers like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' received significantly higher views and engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life and partner understanding (or5gtaBpRVY, my5mP9feI7s) achieved the highest views (1,666 and 1,766) and likes.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on core relationship and marriage communication struggles.

weak_patterns.evidence: YdWh4cDOE64 ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…') received only 10 views, indicating pure abstract shayari underperforms compared to situational storytelling.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic rants; anchor every emotion to a specific domestic or relationship situation.
